classification: The full bounded 90-second post-trigger capture ended at 10:57:12 UTC without reaching the packet cap. The Egress test duration was 202.37 seconds and the capture elapsed time was about 201.58 seconds, so their reported durations align closely; exact process start timestamps were not recorded. The capture observed 2664 VPN endpoint UDP packets, zero direct DNS packets, and one global IPv6 TCP/443 packet. AP-station filtering cannot attribute packets to the probe UID. Treat this as useful correlated diagnostic evidence, not a UID-level clean pass or proof of a leak.
